items.raw_excerpt: Portugal’s condominium management sector is calling for changes to the country’s building insurance legislation after this year’s severe storms exposed the current system of individual insurance policies for apartment owners.
items.summary_en: Portugal's condominium managers are asking the government to change insurance laws. They want a single insurance policy for each building instead of separate policies for each apartment owner. This year's severe storms showed the current system does not work well.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 아파트 관리자들이 건물 보험 제도 개선을 정부에 요청하고 나섰다. 현재는 각 가구가 개별 보험에 가입하지만, 올해 심한 폭풍 이후 건물 단위 통합 보험이 필요하다는 지적이 나온다.
items.title_en: Condominium managers in Portugal want one building insurance policy

items.raw_excerpt: After Hamilton neighbourhoods were blanketed by an unknown black substance in early July, Ontario's official opposition is calling on the government to share what it knows about the recurring issue.
items.summary_en: An unknown black substance covered Hamilton, Ontario neighborhoods in early July. The opposition party wants the government to share what it knows about the issue. This soot problem has happened before in the area.
items.summary_ko: 7월 초, 온타리오주 해밀턴의 여러 동네가 정체 모를 검은 물질로 뒤덮였습니다. 주 야당은 정부가 이 물질에 대해 알고 있는 내용을 공개해야 한다고 촉구하고 있습니다. 당국은 이런 검은 물질 문제가 이전에도 발생한 적이 있다고 밝혔습니다.
items.title_en: Ontario opposition leader says premier has answers about black substance in Hamilton

items.title_original: Ontario NDP leader says Premier Doug Ford 'has the answers' to what's in soot blanketing Hamilton communities

items.raw_excerpt: Puerto Vallarta is practicing a balancing act as it promotes growth while also trying to preserve the natural beauty that makes it special.
items.summary_en: Puerto Vallarta is working to grow its tourism while protecting its beaches and forests. The city wants more visitors but also needs to keep its natural beauty. Local leaders are looking for ways to do both.

items.raw_excerpt: Legislação determina que a dispensação de medicamentos só pode ocorrer em farmácias e drogarias, com assistência farmacêutica obrigatória.
items.summary_en: A Brazilian council asked the Public Ministry of São Paulo to investigate the sale of medicines in vending machines. The law requires medicines to be sold only in pharmacies with professional assistance.

items.raw_excerpt: 20-year-old Saskatoon athlete says winning the gold medal in the pommel horse event was "so special."

items.raw_excerpt: A resident on a central Auckland street say multiple boarded up houses and vacant lots have been "left to rot", after a major Kainga Ora project was stopped last year.
items.summary_en: People on a central Auckland street say boarded-up houses and empty lots attract illegal dumping. The homes were part of a Kainga Ora housing project that was stopped last year. Locals say the area has been left to rot.

items.title_en: Auckland residents complain about Kainga Ora ghost homes left to rot

items.raw_excerpt: Entre novembro e janeiro, o parque de Coimbra vai ter mercadinho, fábrica do riso e workshops de culinária.
items.summary_en: Between November and January, the park in Coimbra will have a Christmas market, a laughter factory, and cooking workshops. The children's theme park becomes a holiday village for families.
